name: dz-launchpad
description: A Windows desktop launcher and Workshop mod manager for DayZ
author: z0mbi3jesus

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build:electron: npm run build:info && esbuild electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --external:koffi --outdir=dist-electron && esbuild electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/preload.js
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run test:server-browser && vite build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --dir --config.directories.output=launcher-build
scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run test:server-browser && vite build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config.directories.output=launcher-build
